text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: difference in mean quantile score over the five decision substations (D5, D10, D11, D14, D16), rows outside the switching events. Orange: scored year, 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026, with a 99.17% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Blue: replicate year, 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025, estimate only. Dashed line: no difference. The weather is an estimate of past weather (ERA5 temperature, CAMS irradiance).'
